description: Main entry point and root widget for a Flutter dating app, including routing, filter preferences, and UI components for user filtering.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter application, setting up MaterialApp with theme and route configurations.

classes.name: FilterPreferences
classes.description: Data class holding user filter preferences with method to convert preferences into query parameters.

classes.name: FiltersPage
classes.description: Stateful widget implementing the filter UI for selecting preferences, ethnicity, race, and hair color.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initiates the Flutter app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and FiltersPage, with routing and UI components.

methods.name: toQueryParams
methods.description: Converts filter preferences into a map of query string parameters.

methods.name: _apply
methods.description: Builds FilterPreferences from UI selections and displays them as a snack bar.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Resets all filter UI selections to default/empty states.

methods.name: _mapEthnicityToCode
methods.description: Maps ethnicity display name to its code string.

methods.name: _mapRaceToCode
methods.description: Maps race display name to its code string.

methods.name: _buildHairChip
methods.description: Builds a selectable ChoiceChip for hair color options.
